hobbies.title: DIY Headphone Amplifier
hobbies.bodyText:
- Analog headphone amplifier using NE5532 
 - Full Super tone control circuit diagram Schematics from eleccircuit 
 - Modified to add a buffer stage to use as a headphone amp 
 - Should use 3d printed enclosure instead of cardboard scraps now that i have a printer

hobbies.title: DIY NE5532 Microphone Amplifier
hobbies.bodyText:
- Analog stereo microphone amplifier using NE5532 
 - Basic NE5532 circuit to amplify basic electret mic. 
 - Modified from existing schematic. 
    - Converted to actual dual power supply instead of a false ground. 
    - Increase to 15 gain instead of 11 
    - Convert from mono to stereo microphone with an array of 4 mics 
 - Almost perfect sound quality for cheap components, frequently use for online meetings and conference.
